scenes.basis: 18:1 "he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden" - the unnamed garden across the Kidron is Gethsemane by the parallel passion narrative; the arrest (18:3-11) follows there
18:13 "led him to Annas first" - the high priest's house in the city
18:28 "They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium" - the governor's seat in the city
